# Kids Dentist Grayslake
Kids Dentist is Grayslake, Illinois's longest-serving dedicated pediatric dental practice, open since 1994. We provide comprehensive, compassionate dental care designed specifically for children, from infants through teens, as well as patients with special needs. All four doctors are board-certified pediatric specialists (DDS, MS, Diplomates of the American Board of Pediatric Dentistry) who completed their pediatric residencies at the University of Illinois at Chicago.

## Service Area
Grayslake, IL and the surrounding Lake County communities: Waukegan, Libertyville, Mundelein, Vernon Hills, Lake Forest, Round Lake, Lindenhurst, Antioch, Gurnee, and Zion.

## Contact & Location
* Address: 160 Commerce Dr #100, Grayslake, IL 60030
* Phone: (847) 223-1400 (Text or Call)

## Core Pediatric Services
* Preventive Dentistry: Regular check-ups, cleanings, and safe fluoride varnish to prevent decay.
* Restorative Dentistry: Gentle treatments for cavities, including fillings, pulp therapy (baby root canals), and stainless steel crowns.
* Sedation Dentistry: Safe sedation options including Nitrous Oxide (laughing gas) and General Anesthesia for anxious children.
* Special Needs Dentistry: Compassionate, specialized care and adapted environments for children with diverse needs.
* Emergency Dental Care: Prompt care for toothaches, chipped teeth, and knocked-out baby teeth.
* Orthodontic Evaluations: We monitor jaw and tooth development and provide expert referrals to local orthodontists for braces and Invisalign when intervention is needed.

## About Our Doctors
Our practice features four board-certified pediatric dental specialists (DDS, MS, Diplomates of the American Board of Pediatric Dentistry): Dr. Sonia Gutierrez, Dr. Dave Rutcosky, Dr. Sahar Alrayyes, and Dr. Anne-Ashley Compton. All completed specialized pediatric dental residencies and are dedicated to making the dental experience better for every child. Full bios: https://www.kidsdds.com/about/meet-the-dentists
